name: zc_eyes_glow

tests.name: the eyes and the face were both read for every skin at every hour

detail.note: a missing reading means the figure did not project into frame, not that the eyes are dark

tests.name: at noon every skin's eyes read as lit

detail.note: the founder: eyes have to be glowing even when it is day time. Daylight is the hard case -- an emissive keeps its value while the sunlit stone beside it climbs past.

tests.name: the eyes read as lit at every hour tested, not only after dark
